Open assets used by the game (all free to use):

- three.js add-ons in vendor/jsm/ (EffectComposer, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass, EXRLoader, RoundedBoxGeometry, fflate)
  from the three.js package r160, MIT license (see THREE-LICENSE.txt).
- vendor/hdri/sky.exr: a sky HDRI from Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), CC0 (public domain),
  as packed by @pmndrs/assets 1.7.0 (CC0-1.0).
- vendor/tex/concrete-normal.webp and vendor/tex/grain-normal.webp: normal maps from @pmndrs/assets 1.7.0
  (normals 0006 and 0021), CC0-1.0.
- js/icons.js: icons from Lucide (lucide.dev, lucide-static 1.78.0), ISC license:
  Copyright (c) Lucide Icons and Contributors. Permission to use, copy, modify, and/or distribute this software
  for any purpose with or without fee is hereby granted, provided that the above copyright notice and this
  permission notice appear in all copies.
- vendor/sound/: the rain and thunder recordings given by the game's owner for the game (rain.mp3 cut from the owner's
  rain recording; thunder-near.mp3 from the owner's thunder clip; thunder-far*.mp3 from the rain recording's own rumbles).
